metadata.name: bell
metadata.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: The integrated top hanger is shortened by 0.5 unit (from 2.3 to 1.8 units above its shoulder junction) so it reads as a compact nub. The full drawing is then translated upward by 0.25 unit to keep opposite vertical margins balanced: centerline bounds y=2.75..21.25, visible Regular bounds y=1.9..22.1. Straight walls, shoulders, lower lip and clapper proportions are retained. No doubled seams. Owner-approved source; Outline geometry retained through the Filled clapper correction.

review.note: Owner approved Bell after the solid Filled clapper correction. Both styles reviewed at source proportions and Regular 1.70; the Filled clapper is a solid part with no U-shaped recess.

metadata.name: bell
metadata.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper in a solid filled style.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: The compact top hanger and body match the visible Regular 1.70 Outline. The Filled clapper is a solid rounded half-disc: its upper edge closes the opening, while its lower curve and round outside corners follow the Regular Outline exterior. The closed clapper interior is united with its 0.85-unit outer expansion, leaving no U-shaped recess. Body/clapper separation and visible vertical bounds y=1.9..22.1 are retained. This intentional solid interior follows the Filled body treatment; it is not a counter. Fixed fill-only geometry; other Outline weights may differ. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Bell after the solid Filled clapper correction. Both styles reviewed at source proportions and Regular 1.70; the Filled clapper is a solid part with no U-shaped recess.

metadata.name: camera
metadata.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: Rounded rectangular body uses the Folder corner rhythm. The left and right shoulders have explicit 3-unit horizontal ledges at y=6.8 (x=5..8 and x=16..19), with a narrower raised housing to keep both straight spans visible. The indicator is a zero-length segment centered at 17.9,9.5 with round caps, forming a solid circular dot whose diameter follows the stroke. This avoids the hollow-ring rendering of a tiny stroked circle under non-scaling preview strokes at high zoom. The circular lens is centered at 12,13.2. Source bounds x=3..21 and y=4.1..19.9 balance opposite margins. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Camera Outline and Filled at source proportions.

metadata.name: camera
metadata.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens in a solid filled style.

metadata.construction: Rounded rectangular outer shell has bounds x=2.15..21.85 and y=3.25..20.75. Horizontal shoulder ledges at y=5.95 (x=5..7.5 and x=16.5..19) match the narrowed raised housing in Outline. A circular lens counter and small indicator counter preserve recognition without overlapping strokes. Separately authored fill-only study; counters are fixed geometry. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Camera Outline and Filled at source proportions.

metadata.name: folder
metadata.description: A horizontal rounded folder with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: Owner-approved horizontal Folder. Single rounded outer contour with a straight front-panel edge at y=10.9. Bounds x=3..21, y=4.3..19.7; default stroke is 1.7, with visible left/right padding 2.15 and top/bottom 3.45. The approved X=100%, Y=110% geometry is baked into the path coordinates, preserving constant stroke width and the existing part names.

review.note: Owner approved both styles. Y scaling and constant stroke/gap have been baked into the source; the approved shape is now 100% in the Lab.

metadata.name: heart
metadata.description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: The lower silhouette is a slim V with only a slight outward convex bow. Mirrored quadratic flanks depart subtly from straight diagonals and meet a compact rounded tip. Tangents align through the side transitions and tip without inward inflections. The established upper lobes and notch are retained. Outline bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 remain centered. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Heart Outline and Filled after the head alignment and centered-grid review. The reviewed Lab preview used X/Y=95%; these local preview settings are recorded without changing the source geometry.

metadata.name: heart
metadata.description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point in a solid filled style.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: Filled upper lobes and center notch are fitted to the visible exterior of the original Outline at Regular stroke 1.70 (0.85-unit outward normal offset). Offset branches are trimmed at the symmetric center intersection, with cubic segments fitted to within 0.001 drawing unit. The lower slim V and slight outward bow remain as authored. Bounds x=2.4..21.6, y=3.25..20.75 remain centered. No interior counters or strokes. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Heart Outline and Filled after the head alignment and centered-grid review. The reviewed Lab preview used X/Y=95%; these local preview settings are recorded without changing the source geometry.

metadata.name: moon
metadata.description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: The crescent preserves the recognizable lunar silhouette as an intentional circular exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. A radius-8 outer arc and a radius-10 concave inner arc share the original horn endpoints. At the owner request for a deeper inward curve, the concavity is deepened by approximately .75 unit at its midpoint compared with the previous radius-12 revision. The body stays fuller than the initial radius-8 and radius-9 studies. The outer contour, both horn endpoints and Regular 1.70 stroke weight are retained. One closed path avoids doubled edges. Native centerline bounds remain x/y=4.35424869..19.64575131; Regular 1.70 gives equal opposite visible margins of 3.50424869. Rounded stroke joins soften both horns. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Moon Outline and Filled after the fuller crescent and deeper inner-arc revisions. Final geometry uses a radius-8 outer arc and radius-10 inner concavity, at native proportions and Regular 1.70.

metadata.name: moon
metadata.description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity in a solid filled style.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: The filled exterior is the analytical .85-unit outward offset of the revised Outline at Regular 1.70: outer radius 8.85, concave radius 9.15, and radius-.85 joins centered on the original horns. The radius-10 Outline concavity is offset toward its own center by .85. The outer circle center, horn endpoints and native translation are retained. The inner arc has a deeper indentation than the radius-12 revision, as requested by the owner; the default stroke weight and overall dimensions are unchanged. No style-specific scaling or translation is used. Native X/Y=100% and rotation=0 are the reference. Compare contours at equal rotation. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Moon Outline and Filled after the fuller crescent and deeper inner-arc revisions. Final geometry uses a radius-8 outer arc and radius-10 inner concavity, at native proportions and Regular 1.70.

metadata.name: settings
metadata.description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: Six original radial teeth use straight faces with individually rounded transitions. The recognizable gear is a silhouette exception to the rounded rectangle baseline. Opposite teeth are constructed in symmetric pairs about 12,12; the circular hub remains circular. Owner-approved source. The owner-selected 30-degree clockwise orientation is baked into all source coordinates about 12,12 for both styles. This orientation is now native rotation 0 degrees; no SVG or preview transform is needed.

review.note: Owner approved Settings Outline and Filled at the previous 30-degree preview orientation. At the owner's request, that orientation is now baked into both original SVGs and is the native 0-degree baseline. Exterior and hub alignment are preserved at Regular 1.70.

The circular hub counter has radius 2.25, matching the visible inner edge of the Outline hub (radius 3.1 minus half the Regular stroke). Opposite points remain symmetric about 12,12. The counter is fixed geometry; other Outline weights may differ. Owner-approved source. The owner-selected 30-degree clockwise orientation is baked into all source coordinates about 12,12 for both styles. This orientation is now native rotation 0 degrees; no SVG or preview transform is needed.

review.note: Owner approved Settings Outline and Filled at the previous 30-degree preview orientation. At the owner's request, that orientation is now baked into both original SVGs and is the native 0-degree baseline. Exterior and hub alignment are preserved at Regular 1.70.

metadata.name: sun
metadata.description: A clear circular sun with eight short, evenly spaced rays.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: The circular disc preserves the real celestial silhouette and is an intentional exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. At the owner request, the disc radius increases from 4.25 to 5.1 and the eight radial centerlines shorten from 2 to 1 unit, running from radius 8.2 to 9.2. The disc remains centered at 12,12. Round caps and Regular 1.70 stroke are retained, giving equal visible margins of 1.95 units and a minimum disc-to-ray gap of 1.4 units. Overall dimensions are unchanged. Native proportions are the reference; Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Sun Outline and Filled after enlarging the central disc and shortening the eight rays. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.

metadata.name: sun

This follows the owner request for a larger disc and shorter rays while retaining the original overall dimensions and Regular stroke weight. Native X/Y=100% and rotation=0 are the reference. Compare contours at equal rotation. Owner-approved source.
